name: human-gateway
description: Human Gateway: a second brain for a person or a department that shares through a checked preview and your own yes, with approvals that reopen when what they rest on changes.

plugins.name: hg
plugins.description: A second brain for a person or a department: Claude builds a wiki from your own files, which stay on your computer, shares a page through a check, a preview and your own yes, and keeps approvals that reopen when what they rest on changes.

plugins.name: hg-probe
plugins.description: Run once to tell the owner what your Claude environment can do for hg. It only looks: it installs nothing and writes one report file in your working folder.

plugins.name: hg-probe-panel
plugins.description: An optional second step after hg-probe: it opens a small pane beside the chat with one fixed line and leaves a marker the hg-probe report picks up. Kept apart so a surface that refuses it tells nothing about plugins in general.
